scope: Seven selected C99 profiles, six integration checks; native storage/format libraries, no LMX runtime changes.

stages.name: original_download_tree
stages.notes: FatFs official patches and Unicode replacement applied; selected profiles/adapters identical to retained build.

stages.name: retained_tree_after_pruning
stages.notes: No source references to original download trees; network unused at configure/build/test.

tests.name: storage_littlefs
tests.coverage: RAM NOR: format, mkdir, write/sync, rename, remount/read, truncate, remove

tests.name: storage_fatfs
tests.coverage: FAT and exFAT; UTF-8 Cyrillic and accented LFN, Unicode case matching, write/sync/remount/read/unlink; FAT32 separately NOT_RUN

tests.name: storage_spiffs
tests.coverage: RAM NOR: format, write, rename, remount/read, check, remove

tests.name: storage_heatshrink
tests.coverage: 4096-byte mixed binary payload; small streaming chunks, finish/drain, byte-exact roundtrip

tests.name: storage_cbor_interop
tests.coverage: Both directions QCBOR/TinyCBOR; signed integer, UTF-8, double, bool, bytes; truncated-input rejection; known software-binary16 vector

tests.name: storage_flashdb
tests.coverage: 80 blob replacements with GC; KV and time-series reopen/read; direct typed and generic pointer-to-callback object locking APIs

size_interpretation: Actual .a file bytes are stricter than code-only sizes for this profile. BSS is static writable state; caller buffers, heap, stack, medium images and executable runtime are additional and not represented by archive size.
physical_flash_and_power_failure_testing: NOT_RUN; RAM models and C FILE-backed sector persistence only.
full_upstream_suites: NOT_RUN; their source code is retained, but the six self-contained integration checks are the executed tests.
license_review: Original retained notices inspected; selected targets have permissive licenses. FatFs mentions GPL compatibility but is included under its own permissive license.
lmx_wrappers_execution: NOT_RUN; this group exposes native C targets for later LMX wrapping.
